_comment: Window state the nvitk GUI manages for itself. Unlike the other configuration files there is nothing here to fill in: the GUI writes these values when it closes and reads them when it opens, so the layout you leave is the layout you come back to.
_comment_dock_state: Base64 QMainWindow.saveState(). Panel sizes, which docks are tabbed together, and which are floating. Delete the value to start again from the default arrangement; delete the file and the GUI will recreate it.
_comment_performance: CPU threads for the interactive views, resampling, reformats and FFTs. 'workers' is a count, a share of the cores ('75%', the default) or 'all'; $NVITK_WORKERS overrides it for one session. 'async_slicing' turns on Napari's experimental off-thread slicing. Set from the 'CPU: N / M threads' button in the Tools dock.
_comment_statmodels: Statmodels window: dock arrangement of the last session on screen (base64 QMainWindow.saveState) and the window's geometry (base64 saveGeometry). Every new session opens on that arrangement; delete either value to start again from the defaults.
